title: acquisition() calls a player 'worth buying' because the package also contains unrelated good moves; it compares against doing nothing, not against the best package without him
claim: For k>1, acquisition() returns worth=true when bestPackage(include=player) has gains.season>=minGain. The baseline is 'no transfers', so any good move the team could make anyway counts toward the forced player. With k=left (up to 3), almost every free player who fits somewhere passes on the back of the team's best unrelated move. This drives the Telegram lines '🎯 Тебе: забирай X' / '🤔 можно взять X' for players a rival released (decide), '🔜 X скоро вернётся — 🎯 Тебе: можно брать' (injuredTargets) and '✅ X вернулся в строй'. In each case buying X lowers the team's expected points compared with spending the same transfers without him.
evidence: Live data (live-sports-current.json, team 0, bank 200, 2026-10-20), scratch t7.mjs: bestPackage(k=3, season) without constraints = +140.0 (Randle>Jabari Smith Jr. -75; Keldon Johnson>Dyson Daniels +215). With include=Tobias Harris it is +85.3 (Randle>Harris -130; Keldon Johnson>Daniels +215), so acquisition(...k:3,minGain:30) gives worth=true and injuredTargets lists Harris with soon=true. That is the '🔜 Tobias Harris скоро вернётся … 🎯 можно брать' message, yet the move costs 55 FP. Sweep over the top 40 free agents (t8.mjs, decide() defaults minGain 15, monthFloor 0): 9 are 'worth', 8 of them only through a package, and 6 of those are worse than the best package without them (cost 6-99 season FP; their own swap is -4 to -174, e.g. Matas Buzelis: pack +41 vs +140, own swap -174). Rebuilt state at 08:05Z (t16.mjs): Filipowski, Harris, Coby White and GG Jackson are all flagged 'soon/worth' with packages of +217/+161/+120/+75 against an unconstrained best of +287, and none has a feasible solo swap. Filipowski and GG Jackson also appear among the 19 keys in live-notify-state.json 'returns', so such messages were actually sent.
impact: Wrong buy advice in the owner's Telegram whenever 2-3 transfers are left: every rival release and every injured free agent who fits can trigger 'забирай/можно брать'. Following it costs up to ~100 season FP per occurrence and uses scarce transfers.
fix: Measure the player's marginal value: worth iff bestPackage(include=p,k).gains.season - bestPackage(k).gains.season >= -eps and the player's own pair gain >= minGain. Equivalently, compare against the best package that excludes p, or require the pair containing p (pairs.find(x=>x.in.id===p)) to clear minGain on its own. Use the same counterfactual in injuredTargets and in notify 'back'. Add a test: a team with one big available upgrade must not get 'worth' for a mediocre player.

title: Pre-season transfers (unlimited and free until 20.10 21:30 MSK) are capped at 3 in every recommendation; the UI shows '3 из 3'
claim: league-rules.json records the owner's rule that pre-season transfers are unlimited and free until countFrom (2026-10-20T21:30+03:00). fblTransfers() only excludes them from 'used' and still returns left=3. Sports.ru shows transfersLeft=3, not ∞, so transfersUnlimited is never set. As a result transfersLeft()=min(3,3)=3, recommendation() only tries k in [1,2,3], and the notifier builds bestPackage with k=left=3. During the free window the right advice is the full re-optimisation (k=10) at no cost to the weekly limit. If ∞ is ever detected, the notifier prints 'трансферов Infinity/3' while the UI still caps at 3.
evidence: t4.mjs on live data, 2026-10-20: fblTransfers left=3 for all 8 teams. Season-horizon bestPackage k=3 vs k=10: team 2 +120.6 -> +207.0 (4 moves), team 4 +494.2 -> +646.7 (5 moves), team 5 +543.9 -> +600.0, team 6 +633.5 -> +730.0, teams 0/1/3/7 unchanged. So +56 to +152 season FP per team is left out. Sports.ru's counter does not bind pre-season: team 0 has 18 journal rows (10 draft + 8 transfers on 20.10) and still transfersLeft=3, team 6 has 4 transfers and 3 left.
impact: Today (until 21:30 MSK) 4 of 8 teams are shown packages that are 56-152 season FP short of the free optimum. Every user also sees '3 из 3' as if the weekly limit applied. The same flaw will repeat in any future free window.
fix: In fblTransfers return left=Infinity while now < countFrom (compare by time, not date). Make recommendation() loop k up to min(left,10) when left>3, or call bestPackage(k=10) once. Show 'бесплатно до 21:30 МСК' and a countdown. Format Infinity as '∞' in notify-transfers.mjs:71.

title: Transfer verdicts ('💪 Усиление'/'🤡 Ослабление') use a ±15 FP band that is 2-3% of the model's own season SD, so coin-flip moves get a firm label
claim: transferVerdict labels a move up/down/long/short when the season or 4-week gain passes ±15 FP. The tool's own spread model (pointsSpread/explainSwap) gives one swap an SD of ~450-790 FP on the season and ~85-150 FP on 4 weeks, so a +15 gain corresponds to P(gain>0) of ~51% (season) and 54-57% (month). The 'even' band is hit with ~2-3% probability. Verdicts sent to Telegram for every rival and own transfer therefore read as firm judgements on what the advice engine itself would call 'не стоит' (<60%). Separately, the spread ranges are not calibrated as the docs claim: ACCEPTANCE says 72% of 2025/26 outcomes fall inside the 80% range, so SDs are about 19% too narrow, and pointsSpread's comment that game noise 'dominates a one-week horizon' is false (median share 50%, t21.mjs).
evidence: t5.mjs on the 20 real transfers: 'LeBron James > Anthony Davis' gets verdict up (s +79, m +21) with confidence 54% season / 56% month (sdS 708, sdM 143). 'Morez Johnson Jr. > P.J. Washington' gets up at 59%/62%. 'Paul George > Zach Edey' gets long (+98 season) at 57%. Only 1 of 20 transfers is 'even'. Season SDs of single swaps range 458-785 and month SDs 85-150.
impact: Every rival-transfer and own-transfer message in Telegram shows a confident-looking verdict that the model's uncertainty does not support. This misleads the owner about which rival moves are real threats and whether his own moves helped.
fix: Derive the verdict from explainSwap confidence on the horizon, e.g. up if P_season>=0.70 (and P_month>=0.60 for 'up' rather than 'long'), down if P<=0.30, otherwise even. Or scale the threshold by SD (|gain| > 0.52·sd ⇔ 70%). Print the probability next to the label. Widen spreads by the measured conformal factor (~1.19) or recalibrate the 80% range to 80%.

title: UI and Telegram give different packages for the same team; the '15 FP per extra move' rule ignores horizon units and the season gain
claim: The UI's recommendation() picks a smaller package when each extra move adds less than 15 FP on the chosen horizon. The threshold is the same for 'Неделя' (~3 games), '4 недели' and 'Сезон' (~80 games), and it ignores that the season gain of the larger package can be far higher. The notifier skips this rule and posts bestPackage(k=left) as '🧩 Лучший ход', with no 60/70% gate on what it shows. The two channels therefore tell the same GM to do different things at the same moment.
evidence: t2.mjs/t9.mjs, team 0, 2026-10-21, horizon month. Options: k1 Randle>Zion (+46.5 month, +37.4 season, 67%) and k2 Randle>Jabari Smith Jr. + Keldon Johnson>Dyson Daniels (+56.0 month, +140.0 season, 69%). The UI shows 'Сделай этот трансфер' for k1 because 56.0-46.5=9.5<15. Telegram posts 'Лучший ход: 2 трансфера … уверенность 69%' with the k2 package. Following the UI gives up 103 season FP to save one of 3 transfers that expire on Sunday.
impact: Contradictory advice across channels for the GM of team 0 (the bot's FBL_TEAM) and for any other user. The UI rule systematically drops season value to save weekly transfers that expire anyway.
fix: Use one decision function in src/season.js shared by the UI and the notifier. Replace the fixed 15 FP with a shadow price of a transfer in the units of the objective (see the sequential-policy finding), applied to the season or holding-period gain. At minimum, require best.gains.season - f.gains.season < λ before choosing the smaller package. Apply the same confidence and parsimony rules to the Telegram package.

title: Myopic, risk-averse transfer policy: the 70% confidence gate and 'season decides' discard value from a weekly use-it-or-lose-it resource (2025/26 simulation: -128 to -164 FP per season)
claim: Transfers are 3 per FBL week and do not roll over. Under expected-value maximisation, a move should be made iff its expected gain exceeds λ(d,n), the expected value of the best future use of that transfer before it expires: λ=0 in the last window of the week (Sunday 22:00 MSK), small earlier (Bellman: λ(d,n)=E[V(d+1,n)]-E[V(d+1,n-1)]). The tool instead gates on P(gain>0): 60% in the UI, 70% for Telegram alerts, 'забирай' and the 'стоит делать' copy. That is a variance-averse rule unrelated to the weekly budget. The verdict and acquisition logic also put the season horizon first, which values a move as if it were held all season. In reality it is re-tradeable each week; the right horizon is the expected holding period. Price dynamics and the shadow value of bank money are also ignored: bankAfter is not in the objective.
evidence: Simulation on 2025-26 logs (scratch sim_prep.py, sim.py, sim_run3.py). 433 players with Sports.ru positions, linear 8x10 draft by noisy 2024-25 value, 3 transfers per Mon-Sun week, same-position swaps, predictor = 10-game-shrunk per-game rate × availability share × club schedule with empirical spell-length absences, 48 paired runs (6 drafts × 8 teams), with and without a 20000 cap using Sports.ru prices. Gains vs greedy threshold 15 on the month horizon (no-budget / budget): 'tool70' (P>=0.70 using the tool's own pointsSpread with database rel/gameSD) -164.4 (se 24.4) / -128.4 (se 27.8). 'tool' (P>=0.60 plus 15 FP for extra same-day moves) +0.3 / +6.1. Threshold 25: -84 / -70. Threshold 40: -211 / -178. Season horizon threshold 15: -78 / -124. Week horizon greedy: +98..+102 / +39..+74. Reserve and decay (option-value) rules: +5..+29 on month, +25..+83 on week. Transfers are worth ~3,900-4,100 FP per season vs none, so the 70% gate wastes ~3-4% of that.
impact: Following the Telegram 'confident only' advice or the season-first verdicts costs roughly 80-165 FP per season in this simplified market, about 1% of a team total, which can decide places in an 8-team league. The UI's 60% gate is roughly neutral.
fix: Decide on expected gain minus a time-varying shadow price: λ_Sunday=0, λ_early-week≈10-20 FP per 4 weeks (estimate λ(d,n) by backward induction or Monte Carlo on the in-season injury hazards and the free-agent gain distribution). Show the probability as information, not as a gate. Use a horizon that matches the expected holding period (or a rolling re-optimisation value) instead of the full season. Add a small value per unit of bankAfter (FP per 100 credits from the market price slope) and, once in-season price history exists, an expected price change. Validate by replaying 2025/26 with the archived forecasts, as in this simulation.

title: Game-theory blind spot: all 8 GMs get the same few targets, the uniqueness rule makes later buyers breach, and the externality of releasing a player to rivals is ignored
claim: The site is public and has a team selector, so every GM sees the same deterministic advice. The best packages of most teams target the same few free agents, but FBL allows a player on only one team and the later buyer is in breach (checkRules 'duplicate', certain). The page keeps its rosters from load time: it refreshes only on tab or visibility change or the button, through a raw.githubusercontent copy cached for minutes. A GM can therefore follow 'Сделай этот трансфер → Сделать на Sports.ru' for a player another FBL team bought minutes earlier, and Sports.ru will accept the purchase. The 'taken' set also comes only from the derived journal rosters, not from the Sports.ru roster JSON, so an unresolved journal row leaves a held player looking free. The objective is the team's own absolute FP, while standings are relative. A sale that gains me +8 can hand a rival +269.
evidence: t12.mjs (live data, 2026-10-21, season horizon, k=3): Nikola Vucevic is in the best package of 6 of 8 teams, Tyler Herro 5, Dyson Daniels 4, De'Aaron Fox 3. Released-player value to the best rival (bestSwapFor with the rival's bank, after the package): team 1 sells Okongwu (+8 for team 1) and team 7 gains +269; team 2 sells Walker Kessler (-36 leg) and team 7 gains +313; team 4 sells Gobert (+51) and team 7 gains +195. No code path re-fetches rosters before takeAction, and season-ui.js has no polling of sports-current.json.
impact: At most one of the 6 teams told to buy Vucevic can do it. Any simultaneous follower risks a certain duplicate-rule breach and a lawyer appeal. Released stars strengthen rivals in a relative-standing league.
fix: (1) Re-fetch sports-current.json (cache-busting query) when the transfers tab opens and right before showing takeAction; show the roster age on the card and block 'Сделать' if older than ~2 min. Poll every 60 s while the tab is visible. (2) Build 'taken' from derived rosters ∪ live.teams[*].roster sportsIds. (3) Score each sale with a competitive penalty Σ_r P(r takes the released player)·gain_r·w_r, with w_r from the standings (∂P(I finish ahead of r)/∂FP_r), or at least warn 'освобождаешь X: соперник Y получит +Z'. (4) Flag contested targets (how many other teams' best packages include him) and show a fallback alternative.

title: Points scored on the transfer date go to the wrong team: Moscow-dated games of day D finish before 08:00 MSK, but stints give them to the newcomer; finished but unscored games still count as future gains
claim: Sports.ru calendars and journals use Moscow dates. A game dated D in Moscow is the US evening game of D-1, played around 02:00-07:00 MSK on D, before any legal transfer (08:00-22:00 MSK). stints() opens the newcomer's stint 'from: x.date' and closes the leaver's 'to: x.date', and teamPoints/teamFact/playerFact count g.date>=from && g.date<to. So D's game counts for the newcomer, who joined after it, and not for the player sold, who played it for the team. In expectedPoints, a D-dated game that has finished but has no score in the calendar yet (full collection every 2 h; ctx.running is not passed in the transfer views or the notifier) is still treated as 'ahead'. During the first hours of each transfer window, swap gains therefore include games that can no longer be gained.
evidence: t14.mjs: transfer 2026-10-22 (seenAt 07:00Z = 10:00 MSK), sold player scored 40 and newcomer 5 in games dated 2026-10-22. teamPoints = 5, where Yahoo would count 40. expectedPoints for 2026-10-22..26 at today=2026-10-22 with the 22.10 game unscored = 1.94 games (should be ~0.97). The calendar pattern confirms Moscow dating: 10-21: 2 games, 10-22: 11, 10-23: 3, 10-24: 11 matches the US Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri slate shifted by one day.
impact: The app's league table and 'факт' differ from Yahoo by one game day per transfer whenever either player played that night (~45% each, ~15-25 FP per transfer). It can also reward 'buying yesterday's points'. Week-horizon gains are skewed by up to ~25% for one or two hours each morning.
fix: In stints/teamPoints/teamFact/playerFact use g.date > s.from for the newcomer and g.date <= s.to for the leaver, or use the transfer instant (seenAt) against game start times. In expectedPoints treat a Moscow-dated game of today as done after 08:00 MSK unless it is a US afternoon slot, or pass ESPN 'post' states (season-ui already fetches `games`) as ctx.running/done in the transfer context.

title: '🔜 скоро вернётся' alerts fire for Day-To-Day players, say 'можно брать' whatever the confidence, and repeat on each ESPN status or date change
claim: injuredTargets sets soon=true for every Day-To-Day/GTD player (dayToDay → soon), and these players are not 'returning' from anything. The message always reads '🎯 Тебе: можно брать', even when the confidence printed next to it is 'сомнительно'. The 'back' and decide() paths do distinguish 'забирай' from 'не уверенно'. The dedup key includes status and returnDate, so a player moving from Day-To-Day to Out, or ESPN shifting the return date, triggers a new message.
evidence: live-notify-state.json 'returns' holds 19 sent keys: 17 are 'Day-To-Day' (Claxton, Aldama, Filipowski, Nesmith, GG Jackson, Simons, Grant, Kennard, Diabate, G. Allen, Holiday, Sexton, Monk, A. Black, McConnell, Knueppel…) and Tobias Harris appears twice ('Day-To-Day:2026-10-20' and 'Out:2026-10-23'). Current case (t6.mjs): Harris, soon=true, package confidence 56% ('сомнительно'), but the text still says 'можно брать'.
impact: Alert fatigue in the owner's Telegram (19 alerts on opening day) and buy suggestions below the tool's own 60% bar.
fix: Only flag 'soon' for status Out/Suspension with a returnDate within `days`, never for GTD. Reuse decide()'s branching (CONFIDENT → 'забирай', else 'не уверенно', below DOUBTFUL → no message). Key the dedup on player and episode (the injury-history episode id) instead of status:returnDate.

title: An ESPN injury-feed outage makes every watched injured free agent look healthy and sends a false '✅ вернулся в строй'
claim: When espn_injuries() fails, the collector simply leaves espnInjuries out. notify builds ctx.injuries=parseInjuries(undefined), an empty Map, with no warning. The 'back' block treats every id in previous.watch without an injury entry as returned and posts '✅ X вернулся в строй … забирай/можно брать'. All other advice in that run is also injury-blind: it neither replaces injured roster players nor discounts injured targets. The browser UI warns in this case; the notifier does not.
evidence: t19.mjs: same live data with injuries=parseInjuries(undefined) and previous.watch=[202699]. back=['Tobias Harris'] although ESPN still lists him Out until 2026-10-23 (acquisition is worth via the bundled package, see the acquisition finding).
impact: False 'returned' buy messages, and advice that ignores injuries for the length of an outage (2 h collection cycle).
fix: In notify, if !live.espnInjuries (or its fetchedAt is older than ~6 h), skip the 'back'/'soon' blocks, do not reset state.watch, and add a '⚠️ отчёт ESPN недоступен' line. Optionally keep the last good feed in the collector instead of dropping it.

title: Advice ignores the FBL transfer hours (08:00-22:00 MSK) and the week's last window
claim: TRANSFER_HOURS is imported in season-ui.js but only printed in the rules list. The recommendation card ('Сделай этот трансфер' plus the Sports.ru link or 'Записать') and the Telegram 'забирай/можно брать' messages appear at any hour. A move made from them at 22:00-08:00 MSK is a certain breach (checkRules 'time', certain=true → appeal to the lawyer). The 'week' horizon ends on the Sports.ru week (Monday Moscow date) while the transfer budget ends Sunday 22:00 MSK. After 08:00 on Monday the week horizon has no games left, so 'Неделя' shows no gains on the first day of each FBL week.
evidence: grep: TRANSFER_HOURS appears only at src/season-ui.js:3,590 and nowhere in notify-transfers.mjs or season.js advice code. horizons().week.to = weekOf(today).end (Sports.ru week Tue-Mon Moscow, e.g. 2026-10-20..26), while fblWeek is Mon-Sun.
impact: Users can be led into a certain rules breach at night, and the week horizon is degenerate every Monday.
fix: Outside 08:00-22:00 MSK, replace the action with 'Трансферы откроются в 08:00 МСК' and disable takeAction. Have the notifier say 'сделать с 08:00'. Align the week horizon with the FBL transfer week (to the end of the FBL week, plus the following Sports.ru games), or label it clearly.

title: Transfer verdicts judge each leg of a same-day package separately with the final bank; 'Лучше было' is picked on the 4-week horizon although the verdict puts the season first
claim: (a) The notifier reports each deal of a day's package separately, with verdict and 'лучше было'. For chained packages the legs are meaningless on their own: team 0 at 08:11Z had Jokic→Embiid, Embiid→Sabonis, White→Knueppel, Knueppel→Okongwu, Okongwu→Jokic. (b) transferVerdict rebuilds the 'before' roster from today's roster by swapping inId back to outId, and uses the current bank, so later deals of the day corrupt the counterfactual. When inId was sold again the same day, selling() finds nothing and best is null. (c) best comes from transferOptions(sort='month') and must beat the month gain, so 'Лучше было за те же деньги: X' can be much worse on the season, the metric that decided the verdict.
evidence: t5.mjs: 'Nikola Jokic > Joel Embiid' is down at -1294 season and 'Onyeka Okongwu > Nikola Jokic' is up at +1272, both legs of one package whose net effect is undoing White←Sabonis. t18.mjs (synthetic): bought P81 is verdict long (+485 season, -155 month), yet 'Лучше было: P91 +310 за сезон · +54 за 4 нед.', a 175 FP worse season alternative presented as better.
impact: Misleading own-transfer confirmations and rival assessments on package days (common: 8 of 20 deals so far are in multi-leg same-day packages).
fix: Group a team's deals of one date (or one seenAt) into a net package (multiset difference of rosters) and judge the net change with the bank before the package (live balance + Σ inPrice − Σ outPrice). Choose 'best' with the verdict's own primary horizon and require it to dominate on both horizons.

title: bestPackage lets a team keep 3 players of one NBA club by swapping one of them for another player of that club; single swaps forbid this
claim: The club constraint in the LP is max(CLUB_LIMIT, current count), so with 3 players of club A after an NBA trade the package may sell one of them and buy another A player, keeping 3. That is a purchase that adds to an over-limit club, which ACCEPTANCE line 107 and clubRoom() forbid. checkRules also flags any roster with 3 of a club as a breach, so the package keeps the team in breach.
evidence: t11.mjs: roster with ids 1,3,5 at club A and free agent 91 (PG, club A, 30/game vs 20). transferOptions(outId 1) = [] and bestSwapFor = null, but bestPackage(k=1) returns ['R1>FA-A'] with gain 388. No team has 3 of one club today, so the bug is latent.
impact: After an NBA trade, the package path can recommend a move Sports.ru should refuse, contradicting the single-swap path.
fix: For a club c with current count n_c>2, add the constraint Σ_{bought in c} x ≤ 0 (no purchases) and keep Σ_c x ≤ n_c. Otherwise use ≤ CLUB_LIMIT. Add a regression test mirroring t11.

title: Stale and contradictory method text: 10-game prior, flat share, 'advised from 70%' while the UI says 'Сделай' from 60%, rounding gives '70%: умеренно'
claim: METHOD.transfers says the forecast weight is 10 games and that expected FP = ФО×share×calendar×ESPN 0/50%. The code uses the calibrated weights (points per minute 20/30 games, minutes 5/2 games with half-life), the availability chain curve and a 10-day rule for Out without a date, and enforcement of the white rule and the club limit is not mentioned. The pick card says 'Сделай этот трансфер' for MODERATE (60-70%) packages, while its own whyBox and ACCEPTANCE say 'Делать стоит от 70%' / 'Moves are advised from 70%'. The notifier's sureness() rounds (Math.round) while the level uses raw thresholds, so 0.695-0.699 prints 'Уверенность 70%: умеренно', the clash season-ui.level() was written to avoid. Telegram alerts also print the 4-week confidence right after the season gain.
evidence: t2.mjs: month, team 0 best = k1 at 67% → 'Сделай этот трансфер' with badge 'на грани · 67%' and text 'Делать стоит от 70%'. data/inseason-calibration.json: rateGames 20/30, minuteGames 5/2. PRIOR_GAMES=10 is used only when minutes are missing (season.js:84).
impact: Users are told one rule and shown another; the method page does not describe the model that produces the numbers.
fix: Rewrite METHOD.transfers from the code (or generate it from CALIBRATION). Either recommend only from CONFIDENT or change the copy to 'от 60%'. Use Math.floor plus a level derived from the floored percent in the notifier, and label which horizon the % refers to.

title: 'Лучшая замена для каждого игрока' and the overview alerts list the same free agent for several roster players, each assuming the full bank
claim: bestTransfers computes one best replacement per roster player independently. The same free agent is often best for two roster players, and each row has its own 'Записать'/'Сделать' and full-bank budget, so doing two rows can be impossible (same player or combined cost). Only bestPackage resolves these interactions.
evidence: t13.mjs (2026-10-21): duplicate buys in the per-player list for 6 of 8 teams (e.g. team 2 Tyler Herro twice, team 4 Dyson Daniels and Vucevic, teams 5/7 Joel Embiid, team 6 Trae Young/De'Aaron Fox).
impact: Minor confusion; a user acting on two rows hits an impossible or over-budget second move.
fix: Mark rows sharing a buy ('тот же игрок, что и в строке …') or de-duplicate by assignment (Hungarian or greedy on gain). Note that each row assumes the whole bank.

title: Swap confidence is over-confident in-season and for the moves the tool actually advises (optimizer's curse); the shown gains are inflated about 30%
claim: confidence = Phi(gain / sqrt(sdA^2 + sdB^2)), where sd = sqrt((rel*sqrt(20/(20+played))*points)^2 + gameSd^2*games). Two things go wrong. (a) The level term shrinks by sqrt(20/(20+played)) as games arrive. That treats all season-range uncertainty as per-game-rate uncertainty, which the season's own games resolve. But remaining-season availability (injuries, rest, late-season shutdowns, trades) does not shrink, so from January the probabilities are too sure. (b) Every advised move is the arg-max of gain over dozens of candidates. Each candidate's in-season value is a noisy estimate, so the chosen gain is biased upward (winner's / optimizer's curse, Smith & Winkler 2006) and the stated probability is too high. No test or script in the repo checks the confidence's calibration, yet the UI says 'Уверенность X%: столько шансов, что обмен действительно даст плюс' and Telegram says 'забирай' at >=70%.
evidence:
Backtest on held-out 2025-26. Pre-season forecasts come from projection_model fitted on targets <2026 (range scales 1.198/0.778, same as the published ones). Season-2025-26 logs are played through exact Python ports of perGame/playRate/chainCurve/pointsSpread; the ports match the JS chain to 6 decimals. Scripts: scratchpad/audit/season-expected-points/bt_stage1.py, bt_stage2.py, bt_conf.py, bt_conf2.py, bt_curse3.py, bt_fix.py.
1) Random pairs among the top 250, pre-season 2025-10-21: calibrated in the middle (bin [.7,.8): pred .747 vs obs .748 for week/month/season) but over-confident in the tail ([.9,.95): pred .92 vs obs .81-.85).
2) Healthy pairs (both played their club's last game), in-season. 2026-01-20 season horizon: [.7,.8) pred .752 vs obs .649; [.8,.9) .853 vs .741; [.9,1] .965 vs .835. 2026-02-24 month: [.7,.8) .751 vs .672; [.8,.9) .852 vs .748. The max-likelihood sd multiplier needed: 1.1 (Oct), 1.25 (Nov-Dec), 1.5-2 (Jan), 2-2.5 (late Feb).
3) Advised moves: draft-like rosters (top 80 by pre-season forecast) against 40 random market players; best gain >=20 and conf >=.70; 9 checkpoints Nov-Mar; 12 seeds. Month: stated .812, won .720 (seed sd .048); predicted gain 85.7 vs realised 62.5 FP. Season: stated .831, won .729; predicted 220.1 vs realised 141.3 FP.
4) Removing the narrowing (k=inf) lowers pair log-loss at 2026-01-20 season from .6415 to .5636, at 2026-02-24 season from .6356 to .5547 and at 2026-02-24 month from .5812 to .5367. It costs about +.01 in December (month .4698 to .4794). With k=inf the advised month moves read stated .774 vs won .746.
impact: Every 'стоит делать / X%' badge, the market alerts (they require >=70%), Telegram 'забирай', the recommended package and the 'Уверенность' KPI. In mid and late season a displayed 75% is really about 65%, and the expected gain of an advised move is overstated by about 27-36% (month about 23 FP, season about 79 FP per move). Pre-season (today) the 0.5-0.8 range is roughly honest.
fix: (1) Recalibrate on data. Fit the narrowing constant (k about 60, or none) and an sd multiplier per horizon and per played-games bucket on 2024-25, test on 2025-26, and ship them in inseason-calibration.json with a --check like the other weights. Or map the raw probability through an isotonic fit. (2) Correct for selection. Shrink each market candidate's in-season deviation from its prior once more by a reliability factor before ranking, or compute P(gain>0) and E[gain] by simulating the arg-max: draw values from each candidate's posterior, take the max, and record the realised winner. (3) Add a regression test that bins the backtest probabilities and asserts |pred-obs| < 0.05 at the 0.7 decision threshold. Measure with Brier/log-loss and the realised win rate of the advised set.

title: Season expectation of injured players counts ESPN's injury-adjusted games a second time (absence counted twice); 70-300 FP per injured player
claim: For ESPN_MODEL_COMBINED players, forecast.games is ESPN's projected games (projection_model.py:587). ESPN often already removes a known absence from it. playRate turns those games into the season share. expectedPoints then also sets every game before the ESPN return date to 0 and restarts the chain at the return, calibrated to that already reduced share. Where ESPN priced the injury, the absence is subtracted twice. Where it did not (stale projection), the code is right. The data show both cases, and the code cannot tell them apart. Shaedon Sharpe: ESPN 27 games, but only 21 club games remain after his 2027-03-02 return, and the code expects 12.2.
evidence:
node scratchpad/audit/season-expected-points/dbl.mjs on the deployed DB and the live Sports.ru/ESPN data (today 2026-10-20). Format: code season games/FP vs. the same player if ESPN already priced the absence.
- Jimmy Butler III: ESPN 39, out until 2027-01-02, 48 games after return: 25.4 g / 526 FP vs 39.8 g / 825 FP (+299)
- Kristaps Porzingis: ESPN 59, until 2026-12-01, 60 left: 44.0 g / 725 vs 58.3 g / 961 (+236)
- Brandon Ingram: 48.7 g / 863 vs 55.3 g / 980 (+118)
- Nic Claxton: 61.6 / 936 vs 69.1 / 1049 (+113)
- Shaedon Sharpe: 12.2 / 161 vs 20.5 / 270 (+109)
- Max Strus +84, Bradley Beal +70
Counter-case: Johnny Furphy has ESPN 61 games while out until 2027-01-02 with 48 games left, so ESPN did not price it there. The model's own games (sources.model.games, not conditioned on the report) are available for every one of these players.
impact: injuredTargets ('buy before he returns', minGain 30 season), acquisition and transferVerdict ('📅 Задел на сезон' vs '🤡 Ослабление'), the Telegram decisions for players a rival drops, and the season forecasts in the standings. Injured stars are undervalued by up to about 300 FP. Today 15 ESPN-sourced players with an Out report are affected.
fix: Pick one source of availability per player. For the chain after the return, use a share not conditioned on the current report: the model's unconditional or healthy-start games (sources.model.games or availability.unconditionalGames, with the healthy shift), or ESPN games only for players with no report. If ESPN games must be used, reconcile them: when G_espn <= club games after return, share_after = min(.97, G_espn/gamesAfterReturn), else G_espn/82. Also record in the DB whether the forecast already contains the reported absence. Backtest the choice on 2025-26 using the injury-history archive.

title: Points of games played before a transfer are credited to the incoming player (Moscow-date vs. tip-off time)
claim: stints() opens the buyer's stint at x.date and closes the seller's at x.date. teamPoints/teamFact/playerFact count a game when g.date >= from && g.date < to, and g.date is the Moscow date Sports.ru files the game under. Most games of a Moscow date D are US evening games of D-1. They tip off at 02:00-05:30 MSK on D and are over by about 08:00 MSK. FBL transfers are only possible 08:00-22:00 MSK, so every such game was played before any transfer of day D. The code still credits it to the incoming player and takes it away from the player sold. Only Moscow-date-D matinees (tip-off 19:00-24:00 MSK) are attributed correctly. Under Yahoo's daily lineups (US dates), and under Sports.ru alike, a game finished before the move belongs to the old roster.
evidence: node scratchpad/audit/season-expected-points/stint.mjs. Team 0 sells #1 for #81 on 2026-10-21 (seen 10:00 MSK). Both played PHI@NY, which ESPN shows tipping at 2026-10-20T23:00Z = 02:00 MSK 21.10; Sports.ru files it under 2026-10-21 (checked against the live calendar and the ESPN scoreboard). Output: 'team 0 points credited: 5'. The sold player's 40 FP are lost and the buyer's 5 FP from before the purchase are credited. Stints: {playerId:1, to:'2026-10-21'} and {playerId:81, from:'2026-10-21'}.
impact: The in-app 'Таблица лиги', 'Место в лиге', the team and player 'Факт' and the fact+forecast totals. A club plays on about 45% of dates, so roughly 70% of transfers have at least one side misattributed by one game (about 10-50 FP each). Over ~3 transfers/team/week this drifts away from the Yahoo standings.
fix: Attribute by time, not by Moscow date. Use the journal row's seenAt (or the 08:00 MSK window opening) as the transfer instant and the game's tip-off: ESPN event time, or Moscow date minus 1 for games before 08:00 MSK. A simple rule: a transfer dated D counts from Moscow date D+1, plus D-dated games with tip-off after the transfer time. Add a test with a 02:00 MSK game on the transfer date.

title: Play-rate prior clamped to [0.5, 0.97]: low-games forecasts inflated up to +25 games; worse than the forecast on the held-out season
claim: playRate uses prior = min(.97, max(.5, forecast.games/82)). A player forecast for fewer than 41 games is valued as if he plays 41 (share 0.5). The prior keeps weight 20 games, so the inflation persists well into the season. The clamp comes from inseason_calibration.py, whose cases only include players with >=20 games and >=10 min last season. Production instead feeds it model or ESPN forecasts that are often far below 41: fringe players, undrafted rookies, injured players.
evidence: Live data, today: 60 of 482 market players have forecast games <41. Among the 45 without an injury, code season games exceed the forecast (x80/82) by 12.8 on average, up to +25.4 (Chucky Hepburn 16.1 to 40.1 games, +216 FP; Tristen Newton +211; Lonnie Walker IV 26.6 to 40.1, +154). Injured: Moses Moody ESPN 12 games to 31.0 (341 FP); Thomas Sorber 17 to 39.5; Nikola Topic 26 to 39.7; Dereck Lively II 31.3 to 40.1 (+109 FP). Held-out 2025-26 (scratchpad bt_forecasts.json, 106 of 484 players with forecast <41): games MAE 17.7 (forecast) vs 23.1 (clamped), bias -2.2 vs +9.9 games; season FP MAE 175.7 vs 234.5, bias -21 vs +77.
impact: Season and month expectations, swap gains and injuredTargets for about 12% of the market. Most affected players are fringe and rarely beat roster players, but injured targets and cheap rookies (the rookie rule pool) are mispriced by 100-200 FP.
fix: Use g/82 clipped only to [0.02, 0.99] (bisection already handles it). Refit priorGames in inseason_calibration.py with the production prior (the forecast's games) and include low-games players. Measure games MAE and bias by forecast-games bucket.

title: Absence chain over-predicts availability of healthy players (+2 to +5 pp, worst at 28 games); the documented backtest is not reproducible and its own numbers contradict the text
claim: The JS chain has no Gamma frailty and no 0.45 hazard cap, unlike availability_model.py. It is scaled so its 82-game mean from a healthy start equals the share, then applied from 'healthy now'. That front-loads availability. The comment (83.7/78.2/86.4%) and ACCEPTANCE line 160 cite a 2025/26 backtest that no script in the repo produces. The ACCEPTANCE table itself shows the chain biased high at every horizon (3: 89.3 vs 86.1; 7: 86.4 vs 83.7; 28: 81.6 vs 78.1, while the flat share 78.2 was unbiased at 28). That contradicts 'over the rest of a season the two agree'.
evidence: Independent reproduction (bt_avail.py): held-out pre-season forecasts, weekly checkpoints 2025-11-04 to 2026-03-17, players who played their club's last game. Next 3 games: actual .840, chain .863, flat .738. Next 7: .811 / .830 / .738. Next 14: .776 / .803 / .738. Next 28: .734 / .782 / .744 (MAE .186 vs .190). Remaining-season games of healthy top-250 players (bt_bias.py), chain/actual: 1.039, 1.074, 1.073, 1.062, 1.091, 1.141 (2026-01-20), 1.108, 1.080, 1.084; flat share 1.03-1.11. grep finds 83.7/86.4/0.194 only in comments and docs.
impact: Week and month expectations of healthy players are about 2.5-3.5% too high, rest-of-season expectations 4-14% too high. This partly cancels between two healthy players, but not in healthy-vs-returning comparisons, team season forecasts or the standings forecast.
fix: Add a reproducible backtest script (with --check) for next-n availability. Calibrate the curve: use the frailty mixture from availability_model, scale to the expected remaining-season share rather than the 82-game mean, or blend chain and flat share with a horizon-dependent weight fitted on 2024-25 and tested on 2025-26. Update the comment and ACCEPTANCE with the reproduced numbers.

title: Gain split puts 100% of an injury-driven gain on 'ФО за матч' when a factor is zero, and suppresses the availability warning
claim: splitProduct falls back to 'everything in the first factor' whenever any factor is <= 0. The usual case is a seller who is out for the whole horizon (expectedGames = 0). The 'why' line and Telegram then say the gain comes from points per game, even when the buyer is worse per game. The 'more than half from availability' flag never fires in exactly the case it exists for. The exactness claim holds only for positive factors.
evidence: node scratchpad/audit/season-expected-points/split.mjs. Seller 30 FP/g, Out until 2027-01-15; buyer 21 FP/g, healthy; month horizon. Output: gain 252.7, parts {perGame:252.7, availability:0, schedule:0}; the seller side has expectedGames 0 of 14 club games. With a return mid-month instead: parts {perGame:-89.9, availability:149.2}. The explanation flips sign and source discontinuously.
impact: Every swap or package explanation and Telegram 'Откуда' line for selling an injured player (the most common reason to sell): the user reads the opposite of the true driver.
fix: Use a 3-factor Shapley decomposition (average of marginal contributions over the 6 orderings; exact and finite with zeros). Or take the LMDI epsilon-limit: replace 0 with epsilon, which assigns the change to the zero factor. Add a test with expectedGames = 0.

title: Transfer verdicts ('💪 Усиление', '🤡 Ослабление', '📅 Задел на сезон') use a fixed ±15 FP threshold and ignore uncertainty; many are coin flips
claim: transferVerdict labels a move from month and season gains against T=15 FP. A season difference has sd of about 350-500 FP, so a 15-30 FP gain is near 50%, yet Telegram posts a categorical verdict about each rival's and the owner's transfers. The confidence machinery (explainSwap) exists but is not used here.
evidence: node scratchpad/audit/season-expected-points/verdict.mjs. Real DB/live data, every legal one-for-one option of all 8 rosters, sampled 1/7. 'long' verdicts: median season confidence .54, 100% in 40-60% (example: season +28 FP, month +1, sd 512, confidence .522). 'up' verdicts: median confidence .63, only 38% >= .70. 'down' verdicts are mostly clear (median .03).
impact: Telegram messages about every new transfer (rivals and own), and the 'Лучше было' comparisons. Labels read as facts on near-coin-flip evidence.
fix: Base the label on the season-horizon confidence (e.g. up/down only when P >= .6 or <= .4, otherwise 'even'), or scale T by the pair sd (T = 0.25*sd). Print the % next to the label.

title: Season-ending detection misses 'remainder of the season' / 'season-ending': Furphy (torn ACL) gets 36.8 expected games
claim: seasonEnding() accepts fantasyStatus OFS or the regex /out for (the )?season|miss the (entire|rest of the|20xx-yy) season/. ESPN often writes 'will miss the remainder of the season' while keeping fantasyStatus OUT with a placeholder returnDate inside the season. The player is then expected back healthy at that date.
evidence: Live ESPN report (live-sports-current.json espnInjuries): Johnny Furphy, status Out, fantasyStatus OUT, returnDate 2027-01-02, comment 'Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season'. The regex returns no match, and the code expects 36.8 games / 244 FP from 2027-01-02. 'Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles' is also unmatched (saved only by a 2027-10-01 return date).
impact: Any season-ended player with an in-season placeholder date is valued for half a season, both as an injured target and as a hold.
fix: Extend the pattern (remainder|rest|entirety|balance) of the (20\d\d-\d\d )?season|season-ending|out indefinitely with surgery. Also treat a returnDate later than the last calendar game as season-ending. Add tests with these real comments.

title: Per-game hazards rounded to 3 decimals in the deployed DB; zero hazards make the chain ignore the share (100% availability)
claim: compact() rounds every float not in EXACT to 3 decimals. forecast.availability.hazards are per-game rates of order 1e-4 to 1e-2, so precision is lost and five players get [0,0]. In chainCurve, mean(e^6) = 1 >= share for zero hazards, so the curve is all 1s and the player is expected in every club game regardless of share. The comment 'Three decimals are far below any forecast's precision' is false for hazards.
evidence: Deployed DB: Kon Knueppel, Brandin Podziemski, Mikal Bridges, Julian Champagnie and Bub Carrington have hazards [0.0, 0.0] while shortSpellsPer82 = 0.016-0.019. Code season games: Knueppel 80.0 of 80 club games (forecast 78; +69 FP), Podziemski 80.0 (forecast 79; +45 FP), Bridges 80.0 (vs share .97 -> 77.6; +38 FP).
impact: 5 players are overvalued by 2-4 games a season (about 2.5% on any horizon). Rounding also distorts the short:long hazard ratio (shape) for every player.
fix: Add 'hazards' to EXACT (or store spells per 82). In chainCurve, fall back to the flat share when h[0]+h[1] == 0.

title: Stale or false method texts in the season UI and docs about expected points, points source and confidence
location: src/season-ui.js:317, src/season-ui.js:413, src/season-ui.js:415, src/season-ui.js:638-642, src/season-ui.js:245-250, docs/ACCEPTANCE.md:142

The code uses calibrated weights (20/30 prior games on points per minute, minutes with a 5/2-game prior and half-life 20/5); 10 is only the no-minutes fallback. 2) It says 'Ожидаемые ФО = ФО за матч × доля матчей × матчи клуба × шанс по отчёту ESPN (не играет — 0, под вопросом — 50%)'.
